description: Save the router rules with the expected version and a reason. Keeps the original revision and updates the Routing rules knowledge document. Run router_rules.test first. Needs a company admin.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

reason.description: Why the rules change. Kept with the revision.

rules.description: The rules document: { version: 1, intake: [...], activity: [...] }. Intake rules { id, description, enabled?, route: "file", emailType, match: { senderDomains?, senderAddresses?, onlyMessage?, automatic?, vendor?, subject?, subjectNot?, body?, bodyNot? } } file a new email without a ticket; route: "join_ticket" (no emailType) adds a vendor email about one order number to the open ticket that already holds that number, and opens a ticket otherwise. Activity rules { id, description, enabled?, route: "ignore", match: { sources, orderStatuses?, eventKinds?, eventSummary?, handledBy? } } skip the agent when every new ticket item matches. automatic: true matches mail a machine wrote; vendor: true matches mail from one of the company's pharmacies or clinical partners. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

version.description: The version you read. A newer saved version refuses the change.
